name: Mirren
epithet: Brother Anselm's sister, held at Calden
appearance: Brother Anselm's younger sister: the same brown skin as her brother and a great deal of dark curling hair, worn loose. Seen only in a thin torn shift, sitting against a bare stone wall, somewhere that is not comfortable.
portrait_alt: Portrait of Mirren: a woman in her thirties with brown skin and loose dark curling hair, in a thin torn white shift, sitting against a bare stone wall and looking up, wary and tired.

relationships.label: her brother, the almoner of Saint Ysolde's
